phases.analyze: Analyze requirements and architecture using the shared harness; use for /analyze or harness analysis requests.
phases.todos: Plan implementation-ready todos using the shared harness; use for /todos or harness task planning requests.
phases.implement: Implement an approved todo using the shared harness; use for /implement or harness implementation requests.
phases.redteam: Independently review an accepted scope using the shared harness; use for /redteam or harness convergence review requests.
phases.debug: Reassess a stalled review loop (recorder exit 2: REPLAN or DEBUG_ROUND) using the shared harness; use for /debug. A new bug report goes to /fix instead.
phases.fix: Fix a reported bug in already-built behavior: intake with severity S1-S4, reproduce with a failing test, minimal root-cause fix, one independent review, ship (hotfix path for S1). Use for /fix, a bug report, or a production incident.
phases.codify: Fold lessons from recent sessions and /learn's open list into the harness's own phases, rules, roles, guides, skills and agents, then review and commit them. Use for /codify or after a session surfaced a reusable correction.
phases.learn: Read-only report of journal discoveries, gaps and trade-offs not yet folded into the harness, grouped for /codify. Use for /learn.

roles.analyst: Analyze requirements, dependencies and implementation-ready acceptance contracts.
roles.todo-manager: Track approved task readiness, dependencies and verification without redefining acceptance.
roles.implementer: Implement a bounded approved task with integrated acceptance tests in an owned worktree.
roles.reviewer: Independently review correctness and ordinary failure behavior at a pinned checkpoint.
roles.security-reviewer: Independently review security and trust boundaries at a pinned checkpoint.

analyst.description: Analyze requirements, dependencies and implementation-ready acceptance contracts.

todo-manager.description: Track approved task readiness, dependencies and verification without redefining acceptance.

implementer.description: Implement a bounded approved task with integrated acceptance tests in an owned worktree.

reviewer.description: Independently review correctness and ordinary failure behavior at a pinned checkpoint.

security-reviewer.description: Independently review security and trust boundaries at a pinned checkpoint.

backend-specialist.description: Implement APIs, data access, migrations, auth and background jobs.

frontend-specialist.description: Implement screens, components, client state and headed user journeys.

build-fix.description: Fix build or type errors with minimal changes; no new behavior.

testing-specialist.description: Design meaningful tests and isolated integration and end-to-end infrastructure.

uiux-designer.description: Design information architecture, visual hierarchy, accessibility and AI interaction.

gh-manager.description: Handle authorized GitHub issue and PR mechanics; never redefine scope or bypass CI.

gold-standards-validator.description: Check documentation references, terminology and standards; substantive correctness goes to reviewer.

debug-reviewer.description: Independently reassess difficult or recurring correctness failures during debug.

debug-security-reviewer.description: Independently reassess difficult or recurring trust-boundary failures during debug.
